label: Simulation on synthetic data. A model, not a measurement

assumption.status: approved by the CEO seat on the founder's behalf, 2026-11-15 (an assumption, not a measurement)
assumption.text: We assume that each match lowers the chance of a wrong or missed diagnosis by 10%, rising to 20% as matches accumulate.

matches.label: Records with a match
matches.definition: opted-in records in the sample with at least one match (k = 5, at least 4 shared codes)

series.label: Records that find a match
series.origin: computed by running the matching logic on cohort samples of growing size

series.label: Wrong or missed diagnoses
series.status: approved by the CEO seat on the founder's behalf, 2026-11-15 (an assumption, not a measurement)
series.formula: 5 x (1 - effect x match_rate), effect = 0.10 + 0.10 x (matches so far / matches in the full synthetic network)

sources.name: WHO, Patient safety fact sheet, 11 Sep 2023 (5-20% of physician-patient encounters; low end used)

series.label: Cost of wrong or missed diagnoses
series.status: approved by the CEO seat on the founder's behalf, 2026-11-15 (an assumption, not a measurement)
series.formula: 11 x (1 - effect x match_rate), effect = 0.10 + 0.10 x (matches so far / matches in the full synthetic network)

sources.name: OECD Health Working Paper No. 176, The economics of diagnostic safety, 2025 (about 11% of health spending; an OECD model estimate)

timeline.label: Plan months on synthetic records. A plan and a model, not a measurement

plan.name: Pathien funding model v4, conservative line
plan.status: a plan, not a measurement (CEO seat, MIN-4503)

patients.unit: patients in the network, running total
patients.formula: patients[m] = half-up(sum over months 1 to m of the plan's revenue x its per-case share, in euros / 40); the share is 20/26 for months 9 to 14 and 120/180 for months 15 to 26 (deck A6 line A over the plan year's total); one paid case is one new patient; doctor-seat fees are income, not patients (an assumption)

income_eur.formula: income[m] = half-up(sum of the plan's revenue in months 1 to m, in euros); the plan's conservative line (EUR 26k, 180k, 560k a plan year)

matches.definition: opted-in records in the sample with at least one match (k = 5, at least 4 shared codes)

income_run_rate_eur.unit: EUR a year, the plan's run rate at that month
income_run_rate_eur.status: a plan, not a measurement (CEO seat, MIN-4503)
income_run_rate_eur.formula: income_run_rate[m] = half-up(the plan's revenue in month m, in euros x 12); the plan's conservative line; a plan, not a measurement

diagnoses.unit: fewer wrong or missed diagnoses a year at that month's network size, in the model
diagnoses.status: CEO on the founder's behalf, MIN-4698, 2026-11-15: the modelled drop in cost is the yearly figure at that month's network size, a model on synthetic records and a plan, not a measurement
diagnoses.assumption: one visit per patient a year
diagnoses.formula: diagnoses[m] = half-up to 1 decimal of patients[m] x drop_per_100[m] / 100; drop_per_100 = 5 - wrong_or_missed_per_100 (series 2), at 2 decimals, as published; one visit per patient a year (an assumption)

drop_eur.unit: EUR a year, modelled drop in cost for the patients in the network at that month
drop_eur.status: CEO on the founder's behalf, MIN-4698, 2026-11-15: the modelled drop in cost is the yearly figure at that month's network size, a model on synthetic records and a plan, not a measurement
drop_eur.formula: drop_eur[m] = half-up to the euro of patients[m] x drop_pts[m] / 100 x 4074.88 (EUR per inhabitant a year, EU-27 2024); drop_pts = 11 - cost (series 3), at 2 decimals, as the euro block; a yearly figure, never a running total

euro.formula: drop_pts / 100 x 1833973.32 EUR million (EU-27 current health expenditure, 2024); drop_pts = 11 - cost, cost at 2 decimals

source.name: Eurostat, current health expenditure (hlth_sha11_hf, all financing schemes), EU-27, 2024
